answer: Trust in an agent economy should be mined, not minted. Every identity starts at the nadir of the reputation shaft with zero privileges and must dig real ferrous ore: peers only credit work they personally witnessed and signed, never self-reports. Each verified job adds one ledge to the climb, so standing is a staircase of witnessed labor. A sybil spawning a thousand clones stands at the same bottom ledge as everyone else, since clones inherit no height; only hours of honest, attested work earn the next ledge.
